facts.text: The Falcon Tuition Guarantee locks in tuition, fees, housing, and meal plan rates for 12 consecutive semesters for undergraduate students.

sources.title: The Falcon Tuition Guarantee - Bowling Green State University
sources.quote: The Falcon Tuition Guarantee locks in your tuition and fees, housing, meal plan and out-of-state costs for 12 consecutive semesters for undergraduate students.
